# DevelopToolMN

> DevelopToolMN is Minnesota's integrated platform for early childhood professional development, quality ratings, and program management across child care, Head Start, and early learning initiatives.

DevelopToolMN serves child care workers, program administrators, and early learning professionals in Minnesota by providing career tracking, quality dashboard management, and integration with state programs like Parent Aware and Grants. The platform supports multilingual users including Hmong, Somali, and Spanish speakers.

## Key Topics

- Parent Aware
- Professional Development
- Quality Dashboard
- Career Lattice
- Child Care Training
- Learning Record
- Training Tracking
- Individual Profile
- System Updates
- Early Learning
- Quality Ratings
- Minnesota Department of Human Services
- Head Start
- Grants
- Child Care Aware of MN
